div.l: Therfore he loued gold in speciall
A gode wyf þere was of besyde bath
But she was somdele defe and that was skath
Of cloth makyng she hade swich an haunt
That she passed hem of ypres and of gaunt
In all the ꝑperissh wyf was there none
That to offryng afore hir shold gone
And yf there did certein so wrothe was she
That she was out of all charite
Hir coủerchiefs were of fyn grounde
I dorst swere they weyde doun a pounde
That on the sonday were vp on hir hede
Hir hosen were of fyn scarlet rede
Full streyte tyed and shoes moist and newe
Bold was hir face and feire and rede of hewe
She was a worthy wōmman all hir lyve
Housbondes at the chirchedore hade she hade v
Wᵗith out other cumpany in hir youth
But there of nedeth not to speke of nouth
And iij . hade she be at Ierm
She hade passed many a straunge streme
At Rome hade she ben and at boloyne
In Galice at Seint Iames and at coloyne
She coude moch of wandryng by the wey
Gattothed was she sothly to sey
Vp on an Aumbler esely she sat
Wele wympled and on hir hede an hat
As brode as is a bokeler or a targe
A fote mantell aboute hir hippes large
And on hir fete a peire of spores sharpe
In felyship koude she laugh and carpe
The remedies of loue she koude ꝑperchaunce
For of þat art she knewe the olde daunce
A gode man þere was of religioıı̄un
That was a person of a poure toıı̄un
But riche he was of holy thought and werke
He was also a lerned man a clerke
That cristes gospell trewly wold preche
His ꝑperysshyns deuoutely wold he teche
Benigne he was and wonder diligent
